scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @social-wiki/kernel && npm run build --workspace @social-wiki/lenses && tsx build.mts
scripts.predev: npm run build --workspace @social-wiki/kernel && npm run build:dev --workspace @social-wiki/lenses && tsx build.mts --link
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names kernel,lenses,server "npm run dev --workspace @social-wiki/kernel" "npm run dev --workspace @social-wiki/lenses" "npm run preview"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm test && npm run check && npm run build
